text: The purpose of this report is to provide information to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority ("TPA") on the Agreement ("Agreement") with the Canadian Automobile Association ("CAA") to implement a Marketing Campaign and Promotion with Bike Share Toronto ("BST") under the business terms and conditions described herein. The Toronto Parking Authority / Bike Share Toronto have secured participation of the CAA in support of "Free Ride Wednesdays", in June 2018.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
